title: Generate a blue noise texture
userPaths: A user generates a tileable blue-noise PNG texture with `blue-noise generate -s <size> --seed <n>`

checks.path: A user generates a tileable blue-noise PNG texture with `blue-noise generate -s <size> --seed <n>`

gotchas: Sizes below 64 skip the FFT path (it only kicks in for powers of two), so a 16px check exercises the spatial Gaussian blur, not the fast path.
